text:
Cass (docs): opened a small PR to correct the console examples for KV-prefix filters and to add a brief migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8120
Ethan (eng-obsv): thanks — can you summarize what's different?
Cass (docs): 1) use `kv.key_prefix` in examples (namespaced field), 2) clarify that prefix grouping aggregates cost/latency by prefix value which can mask per-key spikes, 3) include a jq migration snippet for old flat `kv_prefix`.
Yara (devex): paste the minimal YAML snippet so i can validate screenshots in the playground.
Cass (docs): snippet:
```yaml
dashboard_id: kv-kvprefix-overview
quick_filters:
  - label: "KV prefix"
    field: "kv.key_prefix"
    type: "text"
metrics:
  - name: cost_per_token_usd
    query: "sum:tokens.cost by kv.key_prefix"
```
Ben (sdk): FYI JS/TS use `includeCost` (>=v0.18) while Python uses `include_cost_breakdown`. i'll add a short cross-lang note in the PR and open a tiny SDK sync PR for Go/Ruby snippets.
Ethan (eng-obsv): suggestion for the note: "Prefix grouping aggregates by prefix. To inspect per-key variance, enable sampled per-key traces or query by exact `kv.key`."
Cass (docs): added that wording. also added migration command: `jq '.events[] |= (. + {"kv.key_prefix": .kv_prefix})' old-export.json > new-export.json` and a compatibility line: "Missing `kv.key_prefix` shows as `unknown` in filters."
Yara (devex): ran the YAML in the playground, screenshots attached to the PR. small UX quirk: empty text filter shows all groups collapsed; documented as "Empty prefix = show all groups (collapsed)".
Ben (sdk): opened SDK snippet sync PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/877
preview-bot: docs preview build OK: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/8120
Ethan (eng-obsv): one nit: change metric from `token_cost` to `cost_per_token_usd` to match registry. Cass updated it.
Cass (docs): thanks all  i'll merge once the SDK PR lands and preview updates the embedded examples. planning to ship in the next docs patch release. :rocket:
